name: Clark County, NV
findings: Clark County has 8,309 nonprofit organizations. 2,447 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,926 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clark County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
